parameters.content:
## Receive

The gateway posts the SIP UUI once the INVITE is answered. Header auth. ParseStart splits the raw UUI; ResolveMarket: gateway value, phone prefix, language, PL. A missing correlationId or a UUI version other than 1 answers 400 and the call is released.

## Idempotency

Prompts are loaded once. A re-delivered correlationId returns the existing session without speaking again.

## Identify and open the case

Market row, CASE account lookup by VIN (in-car) or phone number (IVR), then the case with its mandatory fields (account name, origin, description, service type) and the CASE booking prerequisites of 2026-10-23 (country, account, asset, VIN or FIN, plate, mileage unit, assigned dealer, classification, primary contact). The model never sees the VIN or the number; every caller verifies with the four-digit PIN in the dialogue.

## Session

Random session id, one row in ar_sessions per call, state starts at IDENTIFY. The greeting is the market's disclosure plus the ar_prompts greeting in the session language. Every start is logged to ar_events.

## Greet or hand over

Backend down at start: the handover payload is built here and the greeting becomes the handover line.

## AR-01 Session start

Gateway calls this once the INVITE is answered. Header auth. In-car calls carry the VIN; IVR calls carry only the phone number. Every caller verifies with the four-digit PIN in the dialogue (AR-18). Re-delivery of a known correlationId returns the existing session without speaking again.

meta.description: POST /webhook/ar/v1/session/start. Parses the contact-center UUI, identifies the customer, opens the case, creates the session and returns the AI disclosure plus greeting. Idempotent on correlationId.
